resultJson.description:
The hello-python repo is a blank "hello world" playground with no Python source yet. This epic adds a small, self-contained object-oriented programming example in plain Python 3 (standard library only). It should show the core OOP ideas: classes and encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstract base classes and special methods. The example is a classic shapes (or animals) hierarchy that is easy to read and run.

The example is a runnable script plus unit tests, and a short README explaining how to run both. It should use modern idioms: type hints, `abc.ABC`, `@property`, `__repr__`/`__str__`, `dataclass` where it helps, and a `if __name__ == "__main__":` demo. Tests use stdlib `unittest`, so no dependencies or build setup are needed.

tasks.title: Scaffold OOP example package and abstract base class
tasks.description: Create `oop/` directory with `__init__.py` and `shapes.py` containing an abstract `Shape(ABC)` with abstract `area()` and `perimeter()`, a `name` property, and `__repr__`/`__str__`. Add `tests/test_shapes.py` (unittest) verifying Shape cannot be instantiated and that a trivial subclass works.

tasks.title: Add concrete subclasses demonstrating inheritance and encapsulation
tasks.description: In `oop/shapes.py` add `Rectangle`, `Circle`, and `Square(Rectangle)` with validated attributes (positive dimensions via `@property` setters raising ValueError), type hints and `super().__init__` usage. Add unit tests for area/perimeter values, validation errors, and isinstance relationships.

tasks.title: Add polymorphism and special-method features
tasks.description: Add comparison via `__eq__`/`__lt__` (by area, using `functools.total_ordering`) and a helper like `total_area(shapes)` demonstrating polymorphism over a mixed list. Add tests for sorting, equality, and total_area.

tasks.title: Add runnable demo entry point
tasks.description: Add `oop/main.py` (or `__main__.py`) with an `if __name__ == "__main__":` demo that builds a list of shapes, prints them, sorts them, and shows total area. Add a test that calls the main function and checks captured stdout.

tasks.title: Document the example
tasks.description: Add `README.md` explaining each OOP concept and where it appears in the code, plus commands: `python -m oop.main` and `python -m unittest discover -s tests`. Verify the commands work as written.
